QuestInfo.name: [Halloween] Spookghetti and Meatbloods
QuestInfo.0: Zombies are getting into the food for the Masquerade! The Masked Gentleman needs your help.
QuestInfo.1: The Masked Gentleman has requested that you replace the food that was eaten by zombies.
QuestInfo.2: The masquerade is back on, thanks to your mad catering skills!

0.0: Good eeeevening... did that sound good? I'm practicing my vampire impression. Speaking of which! There is no food to eat.\nI'm afraid my rather stocked buffet was ransacked by those zombinious goons. I may as well call this whole thing off, unless...
0.1: Wonderful, marvelous, fantastic! I'll put a shopping list in your quest log. And don't skimp, will you?

yes.0: The shop of Nocturnal Merchant contains items #i2023073# #t2023073#, #i2023074# #t2023074#, #i2023075# #t2023075#, #i2023076# #t2023076#. What about that nasty Emperor Zombora fellow? He must be hoarding most of my buffet.

no.0: You heartless monster! You're not invited to my masquerade ball anymore. I don't know that we're still HOLDING the masquerade, but you're definitely not invited.

1.0: This buffet is going to get me so many ladies!

item.0: I believe there are a few more things on that list I gave you. My party guests cannot go unfatted.

yes.0: Thank you for taking the time to fix my craft services. You'll find a small gift in your inventory.
